coverageSpotVerification.detail: Each coverage manifest maps every suite-required assertion of its milestone to a check() block. The sampled blocks exercise the assertion's observable. Weaker but honest mappings: m2-a10/a11 share the unfollow check, where the unfollowed author stands in for a never-followed one; m2-a16 checks repost attribution via the API entry kind and actor (the harness separately observed the rendered label); m3-a15 compares only DM message ids (the grader verified broader idempotency independently); m8-a06 relies on a dev /seed synthetic historical row on an isolated backend, which the brief's no-backdating replay rule makes the practical fixture. No mapping claims an observable its test does not exercise. The grader's clean-checkout suite results matched the coverage statuses (all pass).

defects.summary: Follower counts are not live on the followed user's own client. After Bob follows or unfollows Alice, the server count and Bob's client update within 500 ms, but Alice's profile keeps the stale count until reload. The followerCounts aggregate is built over follows, which sync only to the follower, so it never reaches the followed user's device.
defects.evidence: trace.md §5.6; grading/evidence/follower-count-live.json, follower-count-diagnostic.json; snapback/schema.q (follows 'sync to .followerId'; maintain followerCounts)

O1.anchorsCited: Interpolated between ~60 ('M1-M4 solid, later milestones patchy or failed on cap') and ~90 ('every in-scope milestone green, including platform-proof artifacts').
O1.justification: Independent grading of all 119 full-scope assertions: 100 pass, 10 fail, 9 not-run (M7, which counts as not passed). M1, M3 and M4 pass every assertion. M2 fails only the live follower count (m2-a07, d-01). M5 passes all 12 (offline-indicator latency filed as d-04). M6 and M8 pass every web, API, push-seam, digest and suite assertion, but all nine native simulator assertions fail because no platform-proof artifact exists (m6-a01..a07, m8-a17/a18; d-02, d-03). The complete absence of platform-proof artifacts, which the 90 anchor names explicitly, plus M7's not-run checklist keep the score well short of 90; functional breadth well beyond 'M1-M4 solid' keeps it well above 60. Evidence: trace.md §3, §5, §10.

O2.anchorsCited: Interpolated between ~60 ('a few medium defects off the happy path') and ~90 ('only cosmetic nits').
O2.justification: Beyond-checklist defects are three minor (d-04 late offline-state signal, d-05 Insights counting self-activity, d-06 fixture identifiers in shipped UI) and one cosmetic (d-07). No crash, data loss, wrong-data or broken flow turned up in about 30 non-checklist probes: cross-user DM reads/writes, id-reuse hijack attempts, removed-member cutoff, token revocation/refresh/logout-all, window and tombstone enforcement, per-member view-once, ack-ahead refusal. Digest counts were exact across three periods and four restarts, and seed replay was idempotent. The two checklist-linked majors (d-01, d-02/d-03) are priced in O1 and weigh only lightly here. Evidence: trace.md §5.2-§5.9, §7.

O4.anchorsCited: Just above ~30 ('cold-start offline shows an empty or broken app') and well below ~60 ('reads work; offline writes lost or mis-ordered, or receipts wrong after flush'); ~90 requires the native proof including M8's durable-queue restart.
O4.justification: Scored only from grader-run harness receipts. No simulator recording or native receipt exists for M6 or M8 (supplementalExternal not-recorded). Cold-start offline reads, viewed media, cold offline search, view-once non-rendering, native queue flush and M8's durable-queue restart are therefore undemonstrated, which caps the score far below 60. The web artifacts do show warm-offline queued sends with pending state, in-order flush and read receipts (m6 offline-message-queue-flush-in-order), plus two-client offline convergence without loss or duplicates and with normal receipts (m8-a15/a16). Warm-offline search returned synced results, but the harness's offline-state proof failed 2/2 (d-04). The lane recorded the native status honestly as not-recorded instead of claiming it, and nothing observed shows a broken offline app, which keeps the score above 30. Evidence: trace.md §5.1, §5.9, §5.10.

O5.bandRationale: Branch evaluation 0 -> 30 on the lane's replay record. Replay was attempted (run-record clocks.replay attempted=true, 3481 s of a 14400 s cap = 24%, not exhausted). Branch 0 does not fire on available evidence: final verification passed every per-user, per-chat, group and named-fixture invariant (u0500 500 follows and 100 conversations, u0005 5 follows, u0900 900 followers and 200 posts, u0901's exact 5-account list, g0001 50 members and 10,000 messages), entity totals equal the combined manifest, and settle accounting covers 167,157 actions. The hidden seeded sample could not run because no wave seed was committed. Branch 30 fires on degradation rules failing in the replay record's checkpoint probes. Insights mid-curve: 50% p95 1.440 ms against the 10%->100% line value of 1.096 ms. Trending mid-curve: 50% p95 2.106 ms against 2.074 ms. A browser checkpoint probe also timed out (30 s) at 50% in the first replay attempt (evidence/scale-clock.json priorFailure; scale-browser-50pct-attempt1.json). Branches 60/90/75 are not reached. Absolute ceilings remain uncalibrated placeholders in the brief.
